```sql
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.year = 2010 THEN ps.points ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.year = 2009 THEN ps.points ELSE 0 END) AS season_points_delta
FROM main.results res
JOIN main.races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN main.drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN main.points_scheme ps ON res.positionOrder = ps.position AND ps.scheme_id = 'PS2010'
WHERE d.driverRef = 'button'
  AND r.year IN (2009, 2010)
```
